input.source: = if details = null then {organicClaim: false} else details
= if details.allergens = null then [] else for allergen in details.allergens return {name: allergen}

output.source: = context merge([{name: details.name, description: details.description, category: details.category, farmOrigin: details.farmOrigin, price: details.price, quantity: details.quantity, startDate: details.startDate, endDate: details.endDate, organicClaim: details.organicClaim = true, allergens: if allergenEntries = null then [] else for entry in allergenEntries return entry.name}, if details.certificationReference = null or details.certificationReference = "" then {} else {certificationReference: details.certificationReference}, if details.harvestDate = null or details.harvestDate = "" then {} else {harvestDate: details.harvestDate}, if details.bestBefore = null or details.bestBefore = "" then {} else {bestBefore: details.bestBefore}])

input.source: = if lastSubmittedDetails != null then lastSubmittedDetails else details
= if lastSubmittedAllergenEntries != null then lastSubmittedAllergenEntries else if details.allergens = null then [] else for allergen in details.allergens return {name: allergen}

output.source: = context merge([{name: details.name, description: details.description, category: details.category, farmOrigin: details.farmOrigin, price: details.price, quantity: details.quantity, startDate: details.startDate, endDate: details.endDate, organicClaim: details.organicClaim = true, allergens: if allergenEntries = null then [] else for entry in allergenEntries return entry.name}, if details.certificationReference = null or details.certificationReference = "" then {} else {certificationReference: details.certificationReference}, if details.harvestDate = null or details.harvestDate = "" then {} else {harvestDate: details.harvestDate}, if details.bestBefore = null or details.bestBefore = "" then {} else {bestBefore: details.bestBefore}])

notes: Form keys contain full paths. Do not add a details group path around them, or the result becomes details.details.*.
The dynamic list outputs [{name: "Milk"}], not string[]. The F1 output mapping converts its entries into details.allergens string[].
Empty optional dates and empty optional certificate reference are omitted during F1 normalization. Required dates remain strings in YYYY-MM-DD format.
Keep lastSubmittedDetails and lastSubmittedAllergenEntries so correction can restore the original inputs even when validation returns product=null.
F1 validation should return validationErrors for the correction table. The current local evaluator uses errors, so its future worker adapter must explicitly map errors to validationErrors.
Only whitelist user-task outputs. Read-only display fields are not written back to stored product; producer inputs remain candidates until the commit task.
F2 productId and update.source must already be present before F2_Load/F2_Source. EnterStockChange is only on the Producer update branch.

Take a task-local loadedVersion snapshot of product.version on entering the User Task; use that unchanged snapshot as the expected version. The display.version field must never become the authoritative version. Identity/ownership still comes from the trusted session, not the Form.
Date ordering, optional-field applicability and provider checks remain service validation. Form required/min settings alone do not implement those business rules.
Add zeebe:userTask and zeebe:formDefinition formId matching each form id. Keep processes non-executable until all task implementations and conditions are configured.
